name: loot_buffer_seconds
notes: audit row 43 BufferSeconds; how long a rolled drop is held for delivery. Code comment "L5", 06-loot L5. Ours, no D3 counterpart

name: aoe_range_yards
notes: Area looting range: your own drops on every corpse of yours within this many yards of you show in one window. The designer, q-0930-59 (option 1, 30 yards); docs/proposals/corpse-loot-minimum.md M6. The code clamps it to 5-100

name: magic_primary_affixes
notes: diablocraft-geyf (GitHub #58). Primary affixes rolled on a Magic item. NOT a D3 number: rarity_tiers.csv says Magic has 1-2 affixes in total and the primary/secondary split is NOT PUBLISHED. 1 is the value CountsFor had compiled in (05-items I8 implementation pick, ours), moved here unchanged

name: magic_secondary_affixes
notes: diablocraft-geyf (GitHub #58). Secondary affixes rolled on a Magic item. NOT a D3 number: rarity_tiers.csv gives 1-2 in total, split NOT PUBLISHED. 1 is the value CountsFor had compiled in (05-items I8 implementation pick, ours), moved here unchanged

name: blood_shard_cap_base
notes: diablocraft-gw9h; docs/proposals/kadala.md 4.2 (ruling q-1007-08). The most Blood Shards an account holds in one mode before any Greater Rift is beaten alone. D3: kadala.csv blood_shard_capacity_base (500)

name: blood_shard_cap_per_gr_level
notes: diablocraft-gw9h; docs/proposals/kadala.md 4.2 (ruling q-1007-08). Blood Shards added to the cap for each Greater Rift level the account has beaten alone in time in that mode, its best, kept when the character is deleted. D3: kadala.csv blood_shard_capacity_increase_per_gr (+10)

name: kadala_legendary_pct
notes: diablocraft-aeo7; docs/proposals/kadala.md 4.7 (ruling q-1007-08). The flat chance that a Kadala gamble is a legendary or set item, not raised by Magic Find or the tier. D3: kadala.csv legendary_gamble_chance (10%). A legendary roll with no unique base for the slot, class and level falls back to the rare roll

name: ancient_chance_pct
notes: diablocraft-t3t8 (ruling 2026-10-10, docs/decisions.md). The chance that a Legendary or Set drop is Ancient, from the ancient_min_tier up and at ancient_min_item_level or more, from every source (kills, chests, Kadala, the first-kill legendary, the set cache). D3: kadala.csv ancient_chance_at_level_70 (10%), drop_rates.csv ancient_primal (roughly 10% at Torment X)

name: primal_chance_pct
notes: diablocraft-t3t8 (ruling 2026-10-10: about 0.25%, 1 in 400). The chance that a Legendary or Set drop is Primal Ancient once the account has unlocked Primals (primal_unlock_solo_gr); it takes the first slice of the roll, so the Ancient chance above is unchanged. D3: kadala.csv primal_ancient_chance (about 0.2%, 1 in 400 to 1 in 500)

name: ancient_min_tier
notes: diablocraft-t3t8. The lowest difficulty tier id that can drop an Ancient or Primal: 5 is Torment I (dc_tier_phase: Normal 1, Hard 2, Expert 3, Master 4, Torment I 5). D3: drop_rates.csv ancient_primal (level 70 Legendary or Set items on Torment I and above)

name: ancient_min_tier_gamble
notes: diablocraft-ax80n (ruling q-1013-21, D3's rule). The lowest difficulty tier id that lets a Kadala gamble, a slot vendor sale, a Kanai's Cube roll or an artisan craft come out Ancient or Primal: 0 is no tier gate, the item level alone (ancient_min_item_level) decides, on any difficulty. A monster drop keeps ancient_min_tier. D3: kadala.csv ancient_chance_at_level_70 (if character is level 70), drop_rates.csv ancient_primal gamble/craft/transmute (no Torment gate named)

name: ancient_min_item_level
notes: diablocraft-t3t8. The lowest item level (the monster's level at the drop, the character's level for a gamble) that can drop an Ancient or Primal. D3: drop_rates.csv ancient_primal, kadala.csv ancient_chance_at_level_70 (level 70)

name: primal_unlock_solo_gr
notes: diablocraft-t3t8. The solo Greater Rift level the ACCOUNT must have beaten, in the character's mode (normal or hardcore), before a Primal Ancient can drop. D3 unlocks it once per game mode for the whole account: drop_rates.csv ancient_primal 'Primal chance' (unlocked after solo Greater Rift 70, once per game mode), kadala.csv primal_ancient_chance (requires unlocking solo GR70 on the account). Read from dc_account_gr_solo

name: ordinary_drop_weight
notes: diablocraft-unxnq (was Pick::OrdinaryWeight compiled into dc_pick_rule.h). The drop weight of every base item that has no weight of its own: D3's common weight, reference/d3planner/data.json dropData (an ordinary legendary is weight 100). The follower relics carry their own, 33 (data/d3/followers_relic_rolls.csv, a third of this), and it does not follow this number. 100 is D3's; a base drops in proportion to its weight over the weights of every base open to that drop
